fields.scope: Complete saved Q5 conserved and sigma polynomials on matching ordered cells with verified Q2 geometry. GL8 integrates polynomial integrals and squared differences on the fitted Q2 map to FP64/geometry-fit roundoff. Pressure, speed and q_sigma metrics are quadrature estimates. Linf and positivity are sampled at GL8 points, with no continuous or between-frame claim.

The native report/CSV must match the kernel names, launch geometry, shared memory, register count and order established by the qualified same-variant NSys capture.
The NVTX range filter is the proven CLI ordinal selection, not a newly instrumented absolute-step payload. NSys capture-local RK ordinals do not establish equal physical states.
Standard kernel replay and all-cache flush perturb cache state. Two launches per family do not measure trajectory-wide distributions or application speedup.
